CONTRACT Demo()
 ASSERT NOT 2 + 3 * 4 <> 14 AND TRUE
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 DIM total AS INTEGER = 10
 IF TRUE THEN
 total = total + 5
 END IF
 ASSERT total = 15
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(10)
 IF FALSE THEN
 EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(99)
 END IF
 EMIT ASSERT_MY_AMOUNT(AS_AMOUNT(1000))
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 DIM values AS LIST OF INTEGER = []
 ASSERT TRUE OR FIRST(values) = 1
 ASSERT NOT (FALSE AND FIRST(values) = 1)
END CONTRACT

FUNCTION Twice(n AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER
 RETURN n * 2
END FUNCTION
CONTRACT Demo()
 ASSERT Twice(3) = 6
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 INPUT count AS INTEGER
 ASSERT count >= 0
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 DIM p AS PAIR OF (INTEGER, BYTES) = PAIR(7, 0x0001)
 DIM xs AS LIST OF INTEGER = [FIRST(p), 8]
 ASSERT LIST_LENGTH(xs) = 2
 ASSERT BYTE_LENGTH(REST(p)) = 2
END CONTRACT

CONTRACT Demo()
 DIM text AS STRING = "a""b"
 ASSERT BYTE_LENGTH(UTF8(text)) = 3
END CONTRACT
